employees.form_help: Only the name and hire date are required. The internal identifier is generated automatically.
employees.national_id_help: A tax or legal identifier, not the system's internal ID.
employees.left_company: This person no longer works here
employees.termination_help: Enable this only when recording a departure; it is not requested for a new employee.
employees.delete_impact: {name} will be deleted with {salaries} salaries, {adjustments} adjustments and {payments} payments. They will also be removed from {scenarios} budgets. This cannot be undone.
employees.delete_description: Their salary history, adjustments and payments go with them. This cannot be undone.

offices.form_help: Entities group people, salaries and financial variables. Plane generates their identifiers automatically.
offices.delete_impact: The {name} entity will be deleted. It has no linked salaries, payments or variables. This cannot be undone.
offices.delete_blocked_impact: {name} cannot be deleted: it contains {employees} people, {salaries} salaries, {payments} payments and {variables} variables. Reassign or remove those resources first.
offices.title: Offices

offices.in_use: This office still has salaries or payments; it cannot be deleted
offices.delete_description: Only an office with no salaries or payments can be deleted.

payments.delete_description: This payment will be removed from the ledger. This cannot be undone.
